rms_norm: return x * torch.rsqrt(x.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps) * gamma
attention_mask:
allowed = key_mask[:, None, None, :].bool().expand(-1, 1, query_length, -1)
if causal:
    q = torch.arange(query_length, device=key_mask.device)[:, None]
    k = torch.arange(key_mask.shape[1], device=key_mask.device)[None, :]
    allowed = allowed & (k <= q)[None, None]
return allowed
transformer_stack:
name = "decoder" if decoder else "encoder"
x = embedding_lookup(ids, weights["shared.weight"])
length = ids.shape[1]
mask = attention_mask(key_mask, length, causal=decoder)
bias = position_bias(weights[f"{name}.block.0.layer.0.SelfAttention.relative_attention_bias.weight"],
                     length, length, not decoder, config.relative_attention_max_distance)
n_layers = config.num_decoder_layers if decoder else config.num_layers
for i in range(n_layers):
    base = f"{name}.block.{i}.layer."
    z = rms_norm(x, weights[base + "0.layer_norm.weight"], config.layer_norm_epsilon)
    x = residual_add(x, multi_head_attention(z, z, weights, base + "0.SelfAttention.",
                                           config.num_heads, mask, bias))
    if decoder:
        z = rms_norm(x, weights[base + "1.layer_norm.weight"], config.layer_norm_epsilon)
        cross_mask = attention_mask(source_mask, length)
        x = residual_add(x, multi_head_attention(z, memory, weights, base + "1.EncDecAttention.",
                                               config.num_heads, cross_mask))
    ff = base + ("2." if decoder else "1.")
    z = rms_norm(x, weights[ff + "layer_norm.weight"], config.layer_norm_epsilon)
    x = residual_add(x, ffn(z, weights[ff + "DenseReluDense.wi.weight"],
                           weights[ff + "DenseReluDense.wo.weight"]))
return rms_norm(x, weights[name + ".final_layer_norm.weight"], config.layer_norm_epsilon)
greedy_generate:
if input_ids.shape[0] != 1:
    raise ValueError("Ця вправа підтримує batch=1")
memory = transformer_stack(input_ids, source_mask, weights, config)
result = torch.full((1, 1), config.decoder_start_token_id, dtype=torch.long, device=input_ids.device)
for _ in range(max_new_tokens):
    logits = decode_logits(result, memory, source_mask, weights, config)
    next_id = logits[:, -1].argmax(-1, keepdim=True)
    result = torch.cat([result, next_id], dim=1)
    if next_id.item() == config.eos_token_id:
        break
return result
moe_ffn:
if not 1 <= top_k <= len(experts):
    raise ValueError("top_k має бути між 1 та E")
flat = z.reshape(-1, z.shape[-1])
probabilities = torch.softmax(linear(flat, router_weight).float(), dim=-1)
gates, indices = probabilities.topk(top_k, dim=-1)
gates = gates / gates.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
output = torch.zeros_like(flat)
for expert_id, (wi, wo) in enumerate(experts):
    token_indices, slots = torch.where(indices == expert_id)
    if token_indices.numel() == 0:
        continue
    values = ffn(flat[token_indices], wi, wo)
    values = values * gates[token_indices, slots, None].to(values.dtype)
    output.index_add_(0, token_indices, values)
shape = (*z.shape[:-1], top_k)
return output.reshape_as(z), indices.reshape(shape), gates.reshape(shape)
